plugins.name: MAKO Decky
plugins.note: Frame generation and spatial scaling for games. Uses the Lossless Scaling DLL: MAKO wants the default public branch of Lossless Scaling, while lsfg-vk 2.0 (part of BoppOS) needs the "lsfg-vk" beta branch, and Steam keeps only one branch installed.
plugins.after_install: Open MAKO in the Decky menu (the ... button) and press "Install MAKO Renderer". Do that again after each update.
